metadata.title: Minimal $\mathfrak{sl}_N$ Complexes of Rational Tangles via the Fukaya Category
metadata.abstract: We compute minimal $\mathfrak{sl}_N$ complexes for oriented rational tangles, denoted $[\![\tau_{u/v}^{O}]\!]_N$, in terms of the topological Fukaya category of the $3$-punctured disk. This demonstrates that the complexes stabilize, allowing us to define a HOMFLY-PT homology for rational tangles.
metadata.comment: 50 pages, many figures, 5 tables. Comments welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 通过三穿孔圆盘的拓扑 Fukaya 范畴计算有向有理 tangle 的最小 slN 复形，证明其稳定性并据此定义有理 tangles 的 HOMFLY-PT 同调。
analysis.breakthrough: 用曲面范畴模型使有理 tangles 的同调计算与稳定性结构相联系。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。结果对象为有理 tangle；摘要未支持任意 tangle 的稳定化，具体函子与分次约定尚需核查。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
